component.name: Disc Rip Trip
component.summary: Put a disc in, get properly named files in your library

description.p: A desktop app that drives MakeMKV, cyanrip, redumper and ffmpeg so you never have to think about title numbers, interlacing, drive offsets, disc serials or filename conventions.

One switch asks what you want out of the disc: video named against TMDb and filed in Jellyfin's layout, audio ripped to every format you configure and verified against AccurateRip, or games dumped, verified against Redump and converted to CHD.
See the project's releases page for what changed.
